description: Validate the reverse-engineered architecture and identify gaps or inconsistencies

actions.description: Check that architecture covers entire codebase
actions.llm_guidance:
Compare:
- Total functions in architecture vs estimated from codebase inventory
- All entry points covered?
- Major files analyzed?

Document any unanalyzed portions

actions.description: Validate that all dependencies are resolved
actions.llm_guidance:
Check:
- No references to undefined functions
- All imports/uses resolved
- External dependencies identified
- No orphan functions (no callers and not entry points)

actions.description: Find missing or incomplete architectural elements
actions.llm_guidance:
Look for:
- Functions without clear categorization
- Clusters with high external coupling
- Missing error handling patterns
- Undocumented configuration dependencies
- Hidden state management

actions.description: Identify elements that may be difficult to migrate
actions.llm_guidance:
Flag:
- Language-specific features (goto, macros, intrinsics)
- Platform-specific code
- Assembly or inline assembly
- Hardware-specific operations
- Performance-critical sections
- Global state dependencies

Create specs/reverse/gap_analysis_report.json with:
- coverage_analysis
- dependency_issues
- architectural_gaps
- migration_risks
- recommendations
